messages:
iza: Quick UX check on the 'Presets & Export' compact modal. Goal: make presets scannable and avoid surprise when a preset changes the delimiter or includes vectors.
noah: Suggestion: present presets as small cards with a one-line summary (max 3 tokens) and a chevron to expand details.
maria: Agree. One-line examples: 'CSV • ids • normalized' or 'Parquet • metadata • zstd'. Keep tokens short.
henry: A11y: preset column should use role=listbox and each preset role=option. Announce when applied: "Preset 'Compact CSV' applied — 2 settings changed." via aria-live polite.
sam: Preview should default to 'Sample (1 row)' with truncated fields and a '[vector truncated]' placeholder. Add a 'Show full preview' link that expands inline.
iza: Interaction: when user edits a field after applying a preset, show a small 'Modified' badge next to preset name and add 'Revert to preset' action.
noah: Copy: modal header = 'Download vectors'; primary CTA = 'Download'; secondary CTA = 'Apply'; overflow = 'Save as preset...'; row menu = 'Download row (ignores preset)'.
maria: Edge-case: if preset requires 512-d and dataset is 768-d show inline warning: 'Preset requires 512-d — current dataset is 768-d'. Provide a link to the optimize docs.
sam: Small QA list: CSV escaping, filename template preview, export size estimate and suggestion to use Parquet for large payloads.
iza: Action items: cards + summaries (noah), listbox/aria-live (henry), sample/full preview + truncated placeholder (sam), modified badge + revert flow (maria). Please react with :white_check_mark: if good and Ill update Figma.
